text: Implemented a documented 1,000,000-interval box quadrature budget, including partial/rounding endpoints, finite input and count validation before Int conversion/allocation, QuadratureError + boxOffsetsEither, and typed HrfSpec.InvalidQuadrature propagation. Legacy block/pulse facades safely refuse excessive work. JVM+JS boundary tests cover Int overflow, Double overflow, exact cap, fractional endpoint, division-rounding endpoint, invalid inputs, impulse/closed-form behavior, and typed duration-generator model errors. Full restored gates passed warning-clean: hrfJVM 310, hrfJS 310, designJVM 448, designJS 447. Removing the work-limit guard caused both bounded selected regressions to fail on each platform; source restored and temporary selector removed before full gates. Retained hashes, commands, logs and mutation runner: docs/verification/quadrature-budget-20261005/receipt.json and logs.tar.gz. Separate sampled-grid allocation finding tracked as bd-01M477F67P8ZJKHSCWSPCECG85. Optional orthogonalization/performance nits untouched. Implementation is local and uncommitted; no publication performed.
